title: On Lipschitzian properties of multifunctions defined implicitly by "split" feasibility problems
summary: In the present paper, a systematic study is made of quantitative semicontinuity (a.k.a. Lipschitzian) properties of certain multifunctions, which are defined as a solution map associated to a family of parameterized ``split" feasibility problems. The latter are a particular class of convex feasibility problems with well recognized applications to several areas of engineering and systems biology.
